info.name: Auction Microservice Milestone 2 Presentation
info.description: Presentation-ready collection for Noah Bouffard Milestone 2. Run from top to bottom with the included local environment. Every request goes through the API Gateway at localhost:8080.

exec: pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test('Shows gateway links', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()._links).to.exist; });

pm.test('Status 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });const json = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('sellerId', json.userId); pm.test('Saved sellerId', function () { pm.expect(pm.environment.get('sellerId')).to.exist; });

pm.test('Status 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });const json = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('bidderId', json.userId); pm.test('Saved bidderId', function () { pm.expect(pm.environment.get('bidderId')).to.exist; });

pm.test('Status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });pm.test('Correct seller id', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().userId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('sellerId')); });
